items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Louis Metcalf was working with us...

ctx.x: Now, you was on this...you had this radio show with this guy telling you, "Lose weight," and everybody's trying to be streamlined, and... She was fat, see, and you see, with a singer it was a comic thing almost; you know, if you're fat, they're going to ridicule you. I'm trying to get her to reduce, for her to get streamlined. She had the face and the legs...

Yeah. So he said, "Don't drink no beer." So by the third night... We're right in the middle of the bar, see, and they've got all this draft beer, see. So I looked at... And they gave me a Coca-Cola, see. So I looked at...I told the man, and he said, "Well, what do you want?" Because you could get all you want for nothing. So I said, "Give me a beer." So Danny looked at me, and I said, "I'm sorry, but I ain't goin' for that." So Louis Metcalf was working with us...
